task_instance: Prepare a sprint-planning meeting pre-read/agenda: search Notion for prior context, draft an agenda with owners/timeboxes and open risks, enrich it with web research on sprint-planning benchmarks (standing in for 'Codex research'), publish it as a Notion page via notion-create-pages, then update it via notion-update-page to reflect a status change (finalize step).
evidence: 1) mcp__Notion__notion-search(query='sprint planning') returned an empty but successful workspace_search result, confirming the Notion MCP connection is live (not a connector-setup failure). 2) WebSearch(query='sprint planning best practices 2026 industry benchmarks agile velocity') returned real, cited industry sources (Easy Agile, Asana, Ariel Softwares) used to enrich the pre-read, standing in for the skill's 'Codex research' enrichment step. 3) mcp__Notion__notion-create-pages created a page titled 'Sprint Planning Pre-Read: Q4 Sprint 14 Kickoff' with meeting context, an agenda table (owner/timebox/expected output per item), risks/open questions, cited research findings, next steps, and a changelog. Returned page id 3e76f44f-5d06-818c-8910-e04c511fe499, url https://app.notion.com/p/3e76f44f5d06818c8910e04c511fe499?pvs=204. 4) mcp__Notion__notion-fetch on that URL confirmed the full page content persisted exactly as authored (agenda table rendered, sources linked, icon set). 5) mcp__Notion__notion-update-page (command update_content) successfully appended a changelog entry, verifying the skill's 'update as plans change' step also works. This exercises the skill's full quick-start workflow (search -> template-based draft -> research enrichment -> create page -> update page) end to end against a live Notion workspace.
